name: Castrillo del Val (Spain)
description: Square green flag with a red stripe in the upper part and a blue stripe in the lower part, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Castrillo del Val (a castle, a cross and a monastery).
history: In 2001 the mayor of Castrillo del Val, Jorge Mínguez, asked Fray Valentín de la Cruz, official chronicler of the province of Burgos, for a flag to distinguish the town; the chronicler replied that the wishes of the residents could go ahead, since the town already had its recognised municipal arms, which should be the origin and reference of the flag.

features.role: Castrillo del Val arms — castle, cross and monastery
